terra.problem: The claim that Papa had rough landings and was met at a dock invents events outside his established world.
Jesus crossing the sea in a boat is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The claim that tax collectors appear around Jesus elsewhere in Matthew needs a reference.
The passage does not say the men were nowhere near a marketplace. No one being able to pass that way does not establish where a market was.
The passage does not say the men were suffering. The explanation presents that as certain rather than as Papa's inference.
The passage does not say that no one else on the shore spoke before the men.
Jesus arriving by boat is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not establish that the sea was in the opposite direction from the tombs or that the herd's route was a straight shot downhill.
The supposed change from a crowd showing up to see Jesus is unsupported. The passage says the whole town did come out to meet Him.
